text: v0.114.27 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v0.114.27 . It includes the live betting logger (every scan with score and clock, offer, bid, and the reason for each pass, uploaded to GitHub every 15 min under phone/live), the Live tab sharing its budget across all live games, and ParlayAPI's pacing fix. Update, use the Live tab as usual, and tell me when some games have finished; I'll grade what it did against the final scores.
